sanskrit_verse:
ये 'प्य् अपेताः स्वधर्मेभ्यः परपिण्डोपजीविनः ।
द्विजत्वम् अभिकाङ्क्षन्ते तांश् च शूद्रवद् आचरेत् ॥
transliteration: ye 'py apetāḥ svadharmebhyaḥ parapiṇḍopajīvinaḥ | dvijatvam abhikāṅkṣante tāṃś ca śūdravad ācaret ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who have abandoned their own dharmas and live by exploiting others' labor while desiring the status of twice-born—such persons shall be conducted with as Śūdras.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with svadharma, not claimed status
Causation is rooted in conscious choice and existential integrity
Capacity-based responsibility arises from the abandonment of svadharma
Restoration logic requires realignment with inherent capacity, not external aspiration
Consciousness alignment supersedes ritual or caste-based pretense
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual has abandoned svadharma AND exploits another's labor AND claims dvija status, THEN assign functional role equivalent to Śūdra until svadharma resumption
IF dvija-status claim lacks svadharma adherence, THEN eligibility for dvija rights is suspended automatically
IF exploitation of others’ labor is detected in a dvija-aspirant, THEN initiate consciousness-realignment protocol without punitive measure
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, any person claiming dvija rights despite abandoning svadharma and engaging in parasitic behavior shall not be granted ceremonial or social privileges of dvijas. The court must assess existential alignment over nominal assertion.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that dvija status is not conferred by desire but by dharma-conformity. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that deviation leads to natural consequence: misalignment with true capacity. Responsibility is proportional to awareness lost. No punitive action is required; the individual is simply realigned with their actual functional capacity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svadharma reclamation process through guided introspection
Assign duties aligned with current consciousness-level to restore integrity
Remove access to dvija-specific rituals until svadharma is resumed
Implement community service reflective of authentic contribution potential
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores order through consciousness alignment, not punishment. Reality responds to truth, not pretense. Dharma is re-established. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
